title: M7 original within-block generated subgroup connectivity bridge

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.difference_shift
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : Finset (ZMod N)) (s : ZMod N), M7.Connectivity.differences (M7.Domain.shift A s) = M7.Connectivity.differences A
spec.guidance: Extensionality and literal finite image membership. The two translations cancel in differences. Both directions, including empty A. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.difference_affine
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : Finset (ZMod N)) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (s : ZMod N), M7.Connectivity.differences (A.image (M7.Action.affine u s)) = (fun x : ZMod N => (u : ZMod N)*x) '' M7.Connectivity.differences A
spec.guidance: Unpack two image members and subtract; distributivity cancels s. Reverse chooses original two support members. Set image, not multiset. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.closure_equiv_top
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (e : ZMod N ≃+ ZMod N) (S : Set (ZMod N)), AddSubgroup.closure (e '' S) = ⊤ ↔ AddSubgroup.closure S = ⊤
spec.guidance: Use AddSubgroup.map_closure for e.toAddMonoidHom and inverse/surjectivity. This is used only for the literal unitEquiv, not a free final action isometry premise. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.connected_action
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (g : M7.Action.Record N) (c : M7.Connectivity.Recipe N), M7.Connectivity.connected (M7.Action.act g c) ↔ M7.Connectivity.connected c
spec.guidance: Unfold connected and act, rewrite difference_affine both blocks. Split g.exchange Bool; Set.image_union combines images, union_comm handles exchange, closure_equiv_top instantiated with unitEquiv g.unit removes the literal unit image. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.connected_shift
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Connectivity.Recipe N) (s t : ZMod N), M7.Connectivity.connected (M7.Domain.shift c.1 s, M7.Domain.shift c.2 t) ↔ M7.Connectivity.connected c
spec.guidance: Unfold connected and rewrite difference_shift twice. This is actual independent translation invariance of differences, not raw exponent gcd invariance. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.scalar_mem
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (a r : ZMod N), a ∈ H → r*a ∈ H
spec.guidance: Every r is natural cast r.val. H.nsmul_mem ha r.val gives r*a using nsmul_eq_mul and ZMod.natCast_zmod_val. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.one_mem_top
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)), (1 : ZMod N) ∈ H ↔ H = ⊤
spec.guidance: If H contains one, scalar_mem with scalar x puts every x in H. Reverse top membership. N=1 is retained. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.gcd_mem
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ a ∈ S, (a : ZMod N) ∈ H) → ((S.gcd id : ℕ) : ZMod N) ∈ H
spec.guidance: Finset induction, gcd_empty=0 and gcd_insert. For insert use Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab (integer Bezout), cast to ZMod N and H.zsmul_mem on the two previous members, then add_mem. Preserve empty S, no coprimality assumed. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.finite_generation_gcd
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset ℕ), AddSubgroup.closure ((fun a : ℕ => (a : ZMod N)) '' (S : Set ℕ)) = ⊤ ↔ Nat.gcd N (S.gcd id) = 1
spec.guidance: Let g=S.gcd id. gcd_mem puts cast g in generated H. All generators lie in zmultiples(cast g) by Finset.gcd_dvd; thus H≤zmultiples g. H=top implies one is an integer multiple of g, hence IsUnit(cast g); use ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime and Nat.gcd_comm. Conversely gcd1 supplies IsUnit g and scalar_mem with inverse puts one in H, then one_mem_top. Do not assume a generator individually coprime; only joint gcd suffices. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.anchored_closure
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : Finset (ZMod N)), (0 : ZMod N) ∈ A → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ B → AddSubgroup.closure (M7.Connectivity.differences A ∪ M7.Connectivity.differences B) = AddSubgroup.closure ((A : Set (ZMod N)) ∪ (B : Set (ZMod N)))
spec.guidance: Two closure inclusions. Difference of support elements belongs to subgroup generated by union. Conversely a=a-0 gives a difference in its own anchored block. No raw unanchored gcd claim. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.nat_support_image
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : Finset (ZMod N)), (fun a : ℕ => (a : ZMod N)) '' ((M7.Supports.natSupport A ∪ M7.Supports.natSupport B : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) = (A : Set (ZMod N)) ∪ (B : Set (ZMod N))
spec.guidance: Unpack Finset union/image memberships and use ZMod.natCast_zmod_val. This directly identifies literal residue supports, not chosen encodings. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.anchored_gcd
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : Finset (ZMod N)), (0 : ZMod N) ∈ A → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ B → (M7.Connectivity.connected (A,B) ↔ M7.Domain.connectivityGcd A B = 1)
spec.guidance: Unfold connected and anchored arithmetic connectivityGcd. Rewrite anchored_closure and backwards nat_support_image; exact finite_generation_gcd. Both directions required, especially connected→gcd. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.connected_admissible
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Connectivity.Recipe N), c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2 → M7.Connectivity.connected c → M6.Final.Admissible N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)
spec.guidance: Use full anchored_gcd forward direction, then accepted M7.Domain.admissible. The public premise is the original generated subgroup connectedness, not supplied gcd. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Connectivity.anchor_admissible
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Connectivity.Recipe N), 0 < w → c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → M7.Connectivity.connected c → ∃ q ∈ c.1, ∃ r ∈ c.2, M6.Final.Admissible N (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Domain.shift c.1 (-q))) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Domain.shift c.2 (-r)))
spec.guidance: Positive card supplies actual members q,r. Existing Domain.shift_card and shift_anchor give equal weight and anchors; connected_shift preserves original connectedness. Apply connected_admissible. Includes w=1,N=1; no given normalization witness premise. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
